answer: Admission mints one nontransferable sable ticket after an agent locks 55 POA for 9 epochs and completes 4 unpredictable tasks. 6 of 9 rotating jurors compare the wander commitment with delayed execution traces recorded in a reef accumulator. A second correlated identity costs twice the first bond and each later one doubles again, making k sybils cost 55(2^k-1) POA. Consensus verifies locks, trace hashes, jury signatures, and accumulator inclusion before paying.
